pages.title: Do Not Crunch Nearby
pages.text: Learn this native encounter’s stated tactics and earn its real defeat: a Wretch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: With the installed integration it follows the native post-Forsaken rule. Eating nearby attracts it; three successful bite blocks break teeth and interfere with its healing bite.
